name: Bronzebeard the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, travelers honor Bronzebeard the Elder in Ironforge. His greeting offers wisdom and a token of esteem. The people of Khaz Modan revere their forebears and their long-lived heritage.

sections.title: Homage to the Mountain Clan
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, spirits and venerable elders appear across Azeroth to share wisdom with travelers who honor the past. In Ironforge, Elder Bronzebeard embodies the Bronzebeard clan’s stalwart resilience. When travelers come to pay their respects, he is quietly pleased that the people still honor the lineage of the old races.

sections.title: Tokens of Ancestral Esteem
sections.body: No great trial or perilous journey is needed. Travelers pause, acknowledge Elder Bronzebeard, and offer a greeting. He returns their good wishes and gives them a Coin of Ancestry, a festival token that recalls the living bond between the present and the generations who forged Khaz Modan from stone and fire.

faq.answer: Elder Bronzebeard is an ancestral dwarf honored during the Lunar Festival. He rests in Ironforge’s subterranean stronghold, where he greets visitors and celebrates their heritage.

faq.q: What does honoring Elder Bronzebeard signify?
faq.answer: Greeting Elder Bronzebeard honors the ancestors during the Lunar Festival. He commends travelers for remembering the roots and ancient sacrifices of Azeroth’s early races.

faq.q: Where in Ironforge is Elder Bronzebeard found?
faq.answer: Elder Bronzebeard stands within Ironforge’s subterranean stronghold, accessible to adventurers exploring the mountain city.

faq.q: Can Horde players speak with Elder Bronzebeard?
faq.answer: Elder Bronzebeard acknowledges anyone who greets him. Horde travelers must brave Ironforge’s fortified depths and evade the dwarven guards to reach him.

faq.q: What reward does the elder bestow?
faq.answer: Elder Bronzebeard offers an ancestral blessing and a festival coin as tokens of goodwill and respect for the ancient generations.

faq.q: Does this quest involve any combat?
faq.answer: No combat is needed to greet Elder Bronzebeard. The journey through hostile territory may still bring danger.

angles.text: As a dwarf, paying homage to Elder Bronzebeard brings you into communion with the noble ancestors who built your mountain kingdom from stone and iron.
Elder Bronzebeard resides peacefully in Ironforge, welcoming Alliance members who come to honor ancient traditions beneath the mountain.
As a member of the Horde, reaching Elder Bronzebeard means entering Ironforge’s fortified core, where stealth or daring can carry you to offer a greeting.
